messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — link-checker flagged a broken anchor in /runtime/configuration. The anchor `#kv-cache-config` 404s: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/configuration#kv-cache-config. Anyone own this page or can we patch a redirect?

docs-bot: Automated scan (link-checker) detected 3 broken anchors in /runtime and 1 missing image. Report: https://ci.redwood.ai/link-checks/scan-1825 (summary attached).

tom: tagging @oliver — I think runtime docs fall under you these days?

oliver: I can take this. Will open a small PR tonight to add an anchor + redirect frontmatter. Also add the anchor to the TOC.

maya: thanks — we want this in the next docs deploy (tomorrow morning). Can you include a redirect so old links keep working?

oliver: yep. Plan: add `redirect_from` entry in frontmatter pointing at the old anchor, and a short copy tweak. Will also add a unit in docs-ci to catch this.

tom: example redirect snippet you can use: 
```yaml
---
redirect_from:
  - /runtime/configuration#kv-cache-config
---
```

oliver: perfect, thanks. I'll follow that.

maya: quick ask for @jen — can we make anchor-404s fail in the link-check job? Right now some anchors slip through.

jen: good call. We currently treat anchor failures as warnings. I'll change the job to fail on anchor 404s and open PR for docs-ci: #1289. Will include a test harness so we don't get noisy false positives.

docs-bot: deploy preview available for PR #4852: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/4852 — includes anchor + redirect + wording tweak.

oliver: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4852 — small changes: add anchor id `kv-cache`, redirect_from entry, fix TOC.

maya: pinging reviewers @sarah @tom — tiny review request, would appreciate a quick look so we can merge before the deploy window.

sarah: LGTM — one tiny nit on phrasing, but not blocking. :thumbsup:

tom: approved.

maya: awesome, thanks all. I'll include this in tomorrow's deploy plan. Note for release: docs anchor fix + redirect + docs-ci anchor-fail job. :sparkles:

oliver: added a short comment in the PR describing the rationale and link to the CI ticket. Will merge after final CI run.

maya: closing the loop — thanks everyone, and @docs-bot for the alert. If anything else pops up from the scan I'll start a separate thread.

docs-bot: scan resolved for /runtime/configuration after PR merge. Next scheduled scan in 24h.
file_notes: Generated Slack thread about a docs anchor and CI fix; contains small code block and PR links
